6902208.name: Chabad Cares Northern Nevada
6902208.note: COLlive, 8 June 2025 ('Innovative Chabad House to Open in Reno, Nevada'): 'Rabbi Moshe and Doba Cunin (nee Brikman) are setting out on Shlichus to establish a new Chabad House in Reno, Nevada. This Chabad House will serve as the launchpad for "Chabad Cares," a new and exciting initiative'; appointed by Rabbi Shlomo Cunin and Rabbi Mendel Cunin of Chabad of Northern Nevada. Its chabad.org listing went up 9 June 2025.
